description: ddlpy is Deltares' Python interface to Rijkswaterstaat's Data Distributie Laag water-data service. It filters available stations and variables, retrieves selected measurements, splits large requests and converts results to Pandas or xarray objects. Command-line examples select water-level stations and date intervals, while additional examples write station observations to NetCDF. Coverage follows the Dutch monitoring archive, not a global observation network; dates, sampling frequency and spatial density vary by station and variable. Public source, pip installation and example documentation are free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is dependence on the upstream Waterwebservices and its data availability, which the README directs users to check when requests fail. The client can prepare boundary conditions and calibration observations for Dutch water-system simulations, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). It supplies data-access functions, not a new authoritative measurement series. This review did not query stations, download observations or test API throughput.
